Engagement Letter
Attest Team, HANGS General Contracting LP Engagement
attest@finance-demo.example
To Ferncastle Bank, Commercial Lending, and HANGS General Contracting LP · Dated October 26, 2026
Re: Agreed-upon procedures on HANGS General Contracting LP’s compliance with Sections 6.1(a) and 7 of the
Loan Agreement dated January 15, 2024, as amended, as of and for the year ended June 30, 2026.
Ferncastle Bank (the bank) engages the attest team to perform the procedures listed below. The bank and the borrower
agree to them and acknowledge that they are appropriate for the purpose of assisting the bank in evaluating the borrower’s
compliance with those sections. The borrower is responsible for its compliance and for its records. The sufficiency of the
procedures is solely the responsibility of the bank.
We will perform each procedure as written and report what we found. This is not an examination or a review: we will
express no opinion or conclusion on compliance or on the financial statements. Terms in capitals have the meaning the
Loan Agreement gives them. If a definition does not decide a question, we will report the question and the amounts on
each reading rather than choose one.
The procedures agreed
Procedure 1: Agree each balance in the FY2026 trial balance to the balance sheet and income statement in the borrower’s
FY2026 financial statements, caption by caption, and report any difference.
Procedure 2: Agree each loan on the borrower’s debt schedule at June 30, 2026 to the trial balance. Recompute the principal
due within twelve months from each loan’s payment terms and maturity, and agree interest expense to the trial balance.
Procedure 3: Compute Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 from the trial balance and compare it with the minimum in
Section 7.1.
Procedure 4: Compute the ratio of Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the
maximum in Section 7.2.
Procedure 5: Compute the Debt Service Coverage Ratio as defined in Section 1.1 and compare it with the minimum in Section
Procedure 6: Compute Working Capital as defined in Section 1.1 from the balance sheet’s classification and compare it with
the minimum in Section 7.4. Report the retainage receivable included in Current Assets and the part the borrower’s aging
expects to collect after June 30, 2027.
Procedure 7: Agree the fixed asset register to the trial balance, total its FY2026 additions and compare the total with the limit
on Capital Expenditures in Section 7.5.
Procedure 8: Compare the date the bank’s records show it received the FY2026 financial statements and compliance
certificate with the deadline in Section 6.1(a).
Procedure 9: Compare each amount and ratio on the borrower’s FY2026 compliance certificate with the results of procedures
3 through 7, and report any difference.
